draft.title: Does merging DeepSeekR1, QwQ, and SkyT1 into FuseO1-DeepSeekR1-QwQ-SkyT1-32B-Preview improve date calculation accuracy?
draft.body:
A recent 2025 post shared an interesting merge model called FuseO1-DeepSeekR1-QwQ-SkyT1-32B-Preview, which combines DeepSeekR1, QwQ, and SkyT1 32B models. The original user tested this fusion setup using ollama with IQ4_XS, 32k context, and Q8_0 KV Cache, focusing on tasks like date calculations.

The key question is whether this merged model actually offers better accuracy or reasoning on date-related tasks compared to using DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B alone. Since the test environment details are limited and results are user-reported, it’s unclear if the fusion consistently outperforms the single distilled model or if there are tradeoffs in speed or stability.

Has anyone else experimented with this or similar merged models for date or calendar calculations? What practical differences did you observe in accuracy or responsiveness?
